decisions.name: Scornfang's Treasury
decisions.choice: RETAIN original baseline for now; no bespoke source-authored master justified before heard A/B
decisions.reason: Original quiet home room matches an occupied Goblin salvage/reclamation office with bunks, game table and scribe desk. New money clinks, stealing sounds, screaming pups or loud paperwork would be inventions. Prior Stage4 cellar domestic source risks modern cutlery and should not be borrowed merely to fill a slot.

decisions.choice: OPTIONAL studio A/B comparison, not game replacement

Must avoid waterfall and wildlife ecology. Comparable previous Archive and Watchhouse candidates are not registered.
